Visible named cast: 왕먀오. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
